# Invoice

The order confirmation email is sent automatically when Stripe confirms the payment. Use this template when a
customer (or a customs form) needs a separate invoice; copy the lines from the order in `/admin`.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Invoice / order no. | GTH-YYMM-NNNN |
| Date | |
| Seller | [LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME], [ADDRESS], gethsemane.t12@gmail.com, [TAX_ID] |
| Customer | [name], [delivery address], [phone for the courier] |

| Qty | Description | SKU | Unit price (USD) | Total (USD) |
| --- | ----------- | --- | ---------------- | ----------- |
|     | Handmade olive wood [piece] | GTH-0__ | | |
|     | Shipping ([carrier], tracked) | | | |
|     | **Total** | | | |

Country of origin: [CONFIRM wording]. Customs duties and import taxes, if any, are paid by the customer.

Payment: card (Stripe) · Paid on: [date]

Estimated delivery: [date range] after dispatch.

**Right of withdrawal (EU/UK consumers)**: you can withdraw from this contract within 14 days of receiving the
goods, without giving a reason, by telling us clearly (by email or through the contact form) or with the model form at
https://your-domain/en/withdrawal. We refund the price and the standard outbound shipping within 14 days of your
notice, to the card you paid with. Your legal guarantees are not affected.
